wiki.title: Sade Elhawary
wiki.extract: Zeinab Sade Elhawary ( SHAH-day or shah-DAY) is an American politician and community organizer who is a member of the California State Assembly representing the 57th district. A member of the Democratic Party, Elhawary previously worked as an educator and for Mayor Karen Bass.
